About Me

The person behind the posts

More than a manager — a growth partner for your brand's online presence.

Kanu UshiangSocial Media Manager · Content Creator · Strategist

I specialise in helping food, beverage, lifestyle and product brands show up online with content that actually performs. From strategy and content calendars to eye-catching designs and community management, I handle the full social media engine — so you can focus on running your business.

My approach is simple: strategy before posting, content with a clear purpose, and conversations over vanity metrics. Every design, caption and campaign is built to move your audience closer to a purchase decision.

💡 "I don't just post content — I build systems that turn attention into revenue."
